name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Exec.ite_spec
typeText:
∀ {b : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Cond} {c₁ c₂ : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Cmd}
  {m : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem} {B : Nat} {P : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem → Prop},
  (Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Cond.eval b m) Bool.true →
      ∃ m' k, And (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Cmd.Exec c₁ m m' k) (And (P m') (LE.le.{0} k B))) →
    (Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Cond.eval b m) Bool.false →
        ∃ m' k, And (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Cmd.Exec c₂ m m' k) (And (P m') (LE.le.{0} k B))) →
      ∃ m' k,
        And (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Cmd.Exec (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Cmd.ite b c₁ c₂) m m' k)
          (And (P m') (LE.le.{0} k (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} B 2)))

source.code:
theorem Exec.ite_spec {b : Cond} {c₁ c₂ : Cmd} {m : Mem} {B : ℕ} {P : Mem → Prop}
    (h₁ : b.eval m = true → ∃ m' k, Cmd.Exec c₁ m m' k ∧ P m' ∧ k ≤ B)
    (h₂ : b.eval m = false → ∃ m' k, Cmd.Exec c₂ m m' k ∧ P m' ∧ k ≤ B) :
    ∃ m' k, Cmd.Exec (.ite b c₁ c₂) m m' k ∧ P m' ∧ k ≤ B + 2 := by
  cases hb : b.eval m with
  | true =>
      obtain ⟨m', k, e, hP, hk⟩ := h₁ hb
      exact ⟨m', 1 + k + 1, Cmd.Exec.ite_true hb e, hP, by omega⟩
  | false =>
      obtain ⟨m', k, e, hP, hk⟩ := h₂ hb
      exact ⟨m', 1 + 1 + k, Cmd.Exec.ite_false hb e, hP, by omega⟩
